controles.affirmation: Appel de Milieudefensie depose le 11 fevrier 2025 devant la Cour supreme neerlandaise contre l'arret du 12 novembre 2024 qui avait annule l'obligation de reduire les emissions de CO2
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "In the Netherlands, a group of environmental NGOs and individual claimants (referred to herein as 'Milieudefensie') filed an appeal on February 11, 2025 with the Dutch Supreme Court against the Court of Appeal judgment of November 12, 2024, which overturned a lower court finding that Shell had an obligation to reduce certain aggregate annual volumes of CO2 emissions by 2030."

controles.affirmation: Plainte deposee le 9 decembre 2025 au Royaume-Uni par des plaignants philippins au titre du typhon Odette de 2021
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "In the United Kingdom, on December 9, 2025 a group of claimants from the Philippines brought a claim against Shell plc and The Shell Transport and Trading Company Limited in relation to loss and damage allegedly arising from Typhoon Odette in the Philippines in 2021."

controles.affirmation: "la ste reconnait elle-meme un degre eleve d'incertitude sur l'issue et ses effets"
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "Management believes the outcome of these matters should be resolved in a manner favourable to Shell, but there remains a high degree of uncertainty regarding the ultimate outcome of these lawsuits, as well as their potential effect on future operations, earnings, cash flows and Shell's financial condition."

controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "Adjustments in respect of changes in tax rates and legislation principally relate to the extension of the UK Energy Profits Levy until March 2030, enacted in 2025". data-lake/SHELL.AS/geo_fr.json (note 7 Segment information) : "dont 28,746 Mds $ realises au Royaume-Uni".

controles.affirmation: Reserves prouvees 8 123 M bep fin 2025 contre 9 620 fin 2024 et 9 787 fin 2023 ; -1 497 apres production, -427 avant production ; baisse de 725 M barils de brut synthetique
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "after taking production into account, our proved reserves decreased by 1,497 million boe in 2025, to 8,123 million boe at December 31, 2025" ; tableau reserves "Total | 8,123 | 9,620 | 9,787" ; "Increase/(decrease) before taking production into account ... (427)" et ligne synthetic crude oil "(725)".

controles.affirmation: Reserves = environ huit annees de production 2025 (1 022 M bep)
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : tableau production "Total | 1,022 | 1,038 | 1,019". Nuance : le tableau de reconciliation des reserves retient 1 070 M bep ("Production | (545) | (16) | (2,953) | (1,070)"). Les deux bases donnent 7,6 a 7,9 annees, soit bien "environ huit annees".

controles.affirmation: ROACE tombe a 9,4% en 2025 contre 11,3% en 2024, sous la cible d'au moins 10%
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "Our ROACE on an Adjusted Earnings plus non-controlling interest basis decreased to 9.4%, compared with 11.3% in 2024, mainly driven by lower earnings".

Communique FY2023 (01/02/2024) : "Adjusted Earnings | A | 28,250 | 39,870 | -29". Le chiffre 2023 est 28 250 M$, pas 28 249 M$. Les valeurs 2022, 2024 et 2025 sont confirmees (communique FY2025 : "Adjusted Earnings | A | 18,529 | 23,716 | -22").

controles.affirmation: 8,5 Mds $ de dividendes + 13,9 Mds $ de rachats = 22,4 Mds $, soit 52% du CFFO
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport annuel 2025 : "We returned $8.5 billion to our shareholders through dividends and $13.9 billion through share buybacks in 2025. Total shareholder distributions represented 52% of CFFO*."

controles.affirmation: "La politique affichee est de 40 a 50 %" (le depassement a 52% en 2025 presente comme un ecart a la politique)
controles.verbatim_source: Communique T2 2026 : "we commence another $3 billion of share buybacks, in line with our 40-50% of CFFO through the cycle distribution policy". La politique porte sur l'ensemble du cycle, pas sur un exercice isole : 52% sur un exercice ne constitue pas en soi un depassement de la politique.
controles.correction_proposee: "La politique affichee est de 40 a 50 % du CFFO sur l'ensemble du cycle ; l'exercice 2025 ressort a 52 %."

controles.verbatim_source: .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/SHELL.AS.json, serie PROD_Q (T2) : 3379 (2020), 3254 (2021), 2898 (2022), 2731 (2023), 2817 (2024), 2682 (2025), 2455 (2026) - la serie n'est pas monotone, elle remonte en 2024.
